title: Berkeley orinda Oral Surgery
description: berkeleyoralsurgery.com Berkeley-Orinda Oral Surgery is a private oral and maxillofacial surgery practice in Berkeley and Orinda, California, operating since the 1950s as one of the longest running oral surgery practices in the East Bay. The team of three to four surgeons, Bryan Krey, Daniel Mobati, Greggory Irving and newcomer Alex Romash, are all board certified in oral and maxillofacial surgery, with founders Richard Berger and Craig Bloom now retired. It covers the full scope of oral surgery, from wisdom teeth removal and dental implants to bone grafting, sinus lifts, facial trauma and corrective jaw surgery, with sedation and general anesthesia performed in the office and 3D cone beam CT imaging on site. The Berkeley office is at 2522 Dana Street Suite 202 with phone 510 848 1055, and the Orinda office at 3 Altarinda Road Suite 208 in the John Muir Health building with phone 925 253 1924, open Monday to Thursday 7 45 to 4 45, Friday 7 to 2, plus one Saturday a month for surgery.
